steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the requested vendor-lock configuration before opening the create flow.
Apply the requested read-only ceiling-price configuration.
Enable the setting whose effect on the single-stage create screen is being tested.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory title required for a valid create-screen setup.
Choose the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Assert that the requested product created one line item before inspecting the setting effect.

args.goal: Inspect the single-stage RFQ create screen after enable_tnc_mandatory_button is On and record whether Terms and Conditions is preselected or mandatory and what opens or changes; stop on the resulting screen

steps.note: Observe the setting's screen-level behavior that no dedicated assertion step can otherwise describe.
Assert that the Terms and Conditions control is present on the resulting create screen.
